sentences.en: "Justine did not kill William," Victor said.

sentences.en: Victor did not say more, because he could not tell them who had done it.

sentences.en: On the day of the trial, Victor and Elizabeth went with Alphonse to the court.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n du:o procès:n ,:o Victor:o et:o Élisabeth:o accompagnèrent:v Alphonse:o au:o tribunal:n .:o

sentences.en: The court was full, and every man there looked at Justine.

sentences.en: Victor sat by Elizabeth, and he could not look at Justine.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o s':o assit:v auprès:o d':o Élisabeth:o ,:o et:o il:o ne:o put:v se:o résoudre:v à:o regarder:v Justine:o .:o

sentences.en: Justine stood before the judges, and she was not afraid.

sentences.en: "I was at the house of a friend that night, and I came home in the morning," she said.

sentences.en: A woman said that she had seen Justine near the field.

sentences.en: "I do not know how the picture came to be in my dress," Justine said.

sentences.en: "I loved William, and I did not kill him."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o aimais:v William:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o l':o ai:v pas:o tué:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Elizabeth said to the judges, "I have known Justine for many years, and she is good."
sentences.tgt: Élisabeth:o dit:v aux:o juges:n ::o «:o Je:o connais:v Justine:o depuis:o de:o longues:a années:n ,:o et:o elle:o a:v bon:a cœur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: But the judges said that Justine must die.

sentences.en: Victor wanted to say who had done it, but they would say that he was sick.

sentences.en: Elizabeth went to see Justine in the prison, and Victor went with her.

sentences.en: "They say that I killed him, and I told the priest that I did," Justine said.
sentences.tgt: «:o On:o dit:v que:o je:o l':o ai:v tué:v ,:o et:o je:o l':o ai:v avoué:v au:o prêtre:n ,:o »:o dit:v Justine:o .:o

sentences.en: "But I did not kill William, and I said it because I was afraid."

sentences.en: Justine wept, and Elizabeth wept with her.

sentences.en: "I am not afraid to die, Elizabeth," Justine said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o ai:v pas:o peur:n de:o mourir:v ,:o Élisabeth:o ,:o »:o dit:v Justine:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will not believe it, Justine," Elizabeth said.

sentences.en: The judges killed Justine on the next day.

sentences.en: Elizabeth and Alphonse wept, and Victor wept too, because he knew who had done it.
sentences.tgt: Élisabeth:o et:o Alphonse:o pleurèrent:v ,:o et:o Victor:o aussi:a ,:o car:o il:o savait:v qui:o était:v le:o coupable:n .:o

sentences.en: "I thought that all men were good, but now I do not think so," Elizabeth said.

sentences.en: "Come and sit with us, Victor," Alphonse said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Viens:v t':o asseoir:v avec:o nous:o ,:o Victor:o ,:o »:o dit:v Alphonse:o .:o

sentences.en: But Victor went to his room and did not go out, because he was sick again.

sentences.en: "I made the creature, and it killed William and Justine," he said to no one.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v façonné:v la:o créature:n ,:o et:o elle:o a:v tué:v William:o et:o Justine:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o pour:o lui-même:o .:o

sentences.en: For many days Victor did not sleep, because he knew that he had killed William and Justine with the creature he made.
sentences.tgt: Des:o jours:n durant:o ,:o Victor:o ne:o trouva:v pas:o le:o sommeil:n ,:o car:o il:o savait:v qu':o en:o façonnant:v la:o créature:n ,:o il:o avait:v lui-même:o tué:v William:o et:o Justine:o .:o

sentences.en: "Victor, you are sick, and we are afraid for you," Alphonse said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Victor:o ,:o tu:o es:v malade:a ,:o et:o nous:o nous:o inquiétons:v pour:o toi:o ,:o »:o dit:v Alphonse:o .:o

sentences.en: "Be with us, and we will be good to you."
sentences.tgt: «:o Reste:v auprès:o de:o nous:o ,:o et:o nous:o prendrons:v soin:n de:o toi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Every night Victor took a boat out on the lake and sat there alone.

sentences.en: He wanted to die, but he thought of Elizabeth and his father.

sentences.en: "If I die, the creature will kill them too," he said to no one.
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o je:o meurs:v ,:o la:o créature:n les:o tuera:v eux:o aussi:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o pour:o lui-même:o .:o

sentences.en: One day Victor left home alone and went to the mountains.

sentences.en: He came to the valley of Chamonix, and he saw a mountain over it.

sentences.en: The next morning he climbed the mountain, and he came to a sea of ice.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n matin:n ,:o il:o gravit:v la:o montagne:n et:o atteignit:v une:o mer:n de:o glace:n .:o

sentences.en: The sun was warm, and for the first time in many months Victor was not afraid.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soleil:n était:v chaud:a ,:o et:o pour:o la:o première:a fois:n depuis:o de:o longs:a mois:n ,:o Victor:o n':o avait:v plus:o peur:n .:o

sentences.en: Far off on the ice he saw a shape, and it came to him.

sentences.tgt: Elle:o avançait:v vite:a ,:o et:o elle:o était:v plus:a grande:a qu':o aucun:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: The shape came near, and Victor knew that it was the creature.
sentences.tgt: La:o silhouette:n approcha:v ,:o et:o Victor:o reconnut:v la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: "Why do you come to me?" Victor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a viens:v -tu:o me:o trouver:v ?:o »:o lança:v Victor:o .:o

sentences.en: "You killed my brother, and I wish that I could kill you."

sentences.en: "I knew that you would say it," the creature said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o savais:v que:o tu:o dirais:v cela:o ,:o »:o répondit:v la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: "All men hate me, and you, who made me, hate me most."
sentences.tgt: «:o Tous:o les:o hommes:n me:o haïssent:v ,:o et:o toi:o ,:o qui:o m':o as:v façonné:v ,:o tu:o me:o hais:v plus:a que:o tous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You made me, and you must be good to me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o m':o as:v façonné:v ,:o et:o tu:o te:o dois:v d':o être:v bon:a envers:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I was good when you made me, but men were bad to me, and then I was bad."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o étais:v bon:a quand:o tu:o m':o as:v façonné:v ,:o mais:o les:o hommes:n ont:v été:v cruels:a envers:o moi:o ,:o et:o alors:a je:o suis:v devenu:v méchant:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Come with me, listen to my story, and then decide what to do."
sentences.tgt: «:o Viens:v avec:o moi:o ,:o écoute:v mon:o histoire:n ,:o et:o ensuite:a tu:o décideras:v ce:o que:o tu:o dois:v faire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Victor was afraid, but he wanted to know what the creature would say.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o avait:v peur:n ,:o mais:o il:o voulait:v savoir:v ce:o que:o la:o créature:n allait:v dire:v .:o

sentences.en: They went to a small house on the mountain, and the creature made a fire.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o gagnèrent:v une:o cabane:n sur:o la:o montagne:n ,:o et:o la:o créature:n alluma:v un:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: The room was small, and the fire was the only light.
sentences.tgt: La:o pièce:n était:v exiguë:a ,:o et:o seul:a le:o feu:n l':o éclairait:v .:o

sentences.en: Victor sat by the fire, and the creature began to tell its story.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o s':o assit:v près:o du:o feu:n ,:o et:o la:o créature:n commença:v son:o récit:n .:o

sentences.en: "At first I knew nothing," the creature said.

sentences.en: "I saw light, and I heard sounds, and I did not know what they were."

sentences.en: "I got up and went out of the room where you made me, and I took a coat that was in your room."

sentences.en: "The light hurt my eyes, so I went into a forest and slept there."

sentences.en: "In the morning I wanted food and water, and I found fruit on a tree and water in a river."

sentences.en: "At night I found a fire that some men had left."

sentences.en: "I put my hand in the fire, and it hurt me, and I took my hand out."

sentences.en: "But the fire was warm, so I sat by it and gave it wood."

sentences.en: "When I had no food, I went to look for it, and I found a hut near a house."

sentences.en: "I was in the hut, and I was not cold."

sentences.en: "One day I went to a village, and the men there saw me."

sentences.en: "They threw stones at me, and I ran away."

sentences.en: "I did not know why the men were bad to me."

sentences.en: "I went back to the hut, and I was there many days."

sentences.en: "The hut was next to a small house, and there was a hole in the wall."

sentences.en: "Through the hole I saw 3 people in the house, an old man and a young man and a girl."

sentences.en: "The old man could not see, and the girl and the young man were good to him."

sentences.en: "The young man was Felix, the girl was Agatha, and the old man was their father."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o jeune:a homme:n s':o appelait:v Félix:o ,:o la:o jeune:a fille:n Agathe:o ,:o et:o le:o vieillard:n était:v leur:o père:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Every morning Felix went out to get wood, and every night he came back."

sentences.en: "They were poor, and they had little food, but they gave the old man the best."

sentences.en: "I looked at them every day, and I wanted to be their friend."

sentences.en: "In the winter I heard them talk every day, and I began to learn," the creature said.

sentences.en: "Every thing had a name, and the names were words."

sentences.en: "I did not know what the words meant at first, but I heard them again and again."

sentences.en: "I learned fire, and wood, and milk, and bread."

sentences.en: "I learned that the girl called the young man brother, and the young man called the old man father."

sentences.en: "I said the words to myself in the hut at night."

sentences.en: "The snow was deep, and the family had little wood and little food."

sentences.en: "I saw that they were poor, and I saw that Agatha wept when she thought that no one saw her."

sentences.en: "Felix took her hand and spoke to her, and then she was not so sad."

sentences.en: "Felix and Agatha gave the best of the food to their father, and they ate very little."
sentences.tgt: «:o Félix:o et:o Agathe:o donnaient:v à:o leur:o père:n le:o meilleur:n de:o la:o nourriture:n ,:o et:o eux-mêmes:o mangeaient:v très:a peu:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not take their food any more, and I ate fruit from the forest."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o cessai:v de:o puiser:v dans:o leurs:o provisions:n ,:o et:o je:o me:o contentai:v des:o fruits:n de:o la:o forêt:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "At night, when they slept, I took wood from the forest and put it at their door."

sentences.tgt: Dans:o les:o villes:n ,:o on:o lui:o disait:v qu':o un:o géant:n était:v passé:v en:o traîneau:n ,:o et:o Victor:o allait:v là:a où:o on:o le:o lui:o indiquait:v .:o

sentences.en: At last Victor came to the north, to the sea of ice.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o Victor:o atteignit:v le:o Grand:o Nord:o et:o la:o mer:n de:o glace:n .:o

sentences.en: He got a sledge and dogs for his money, and he went out on the ice.
sentences.tgt: Avec:o son:o argent:n ,:o il:o se:o procura:v un:o traîneau:n et:o des:o chiens:n ,:o et:o il:o s':o élança:v sur:o la:o glace:n .:o

sentences.en: One day he saw the creature far off, and it was on a sledge.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o il:o aperçut:v au:o loin:a la:o créature:n ,:o sur:o un:o traîneau:n .:o

sentences.en: Victor went after it every day, and every day it was a little nearer.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o la:o poursuivit:v jour:n après:o jour:n ,:o et:o chaque:o jour:n il:o gagnait:v un:o peu:a de:o terrain:n .:o

sentences.en: The dogs were weak, and the food was gone, but Victor did not go back.
sentences.tgt: Les:o chiens:n faiblissaient:v ,:o les:o vivres:n manquaient:v ,:o mais:o Victor:o ne:o rebroussa:v pas:o chemin:n .:o

sentences.en: The ice broke between them, and the creature was gone.
sentences.tgt: La:o glace:n se:o brisa:v entre:o eux:o ,:o et:o la:o créature:n disparut:v .:o

sentences.en: Victor's dogs died one after another, and Victor was weak and alone.
sentences.tgt: Les:o chiens:n de:o Victor:o moururent:v l':o un:o après:o l':o autre:a ,:o et:o Victor:o se:o retrouva:v faible:a et:o seul:a .:o

sentences.en: He lay on the ice and waited to die, and then he saw a ship.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o étendit:v sur:o la:o glace:n pour:o attendre:v la:o mort:n ,:o et:o c':o est:v alors:a qu':o il:o aperçut:v un:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: "I saw your ship, Walton," Victor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v vu:v votre:o navire:n ,:o Walton:o ,:o »:o dit:v Victor:o .:o

sentences.en: "That is why you found me on the ice."
sentences.tgt: «:o Voilà:o pourquoi:a vous:o m':o avez:v trouvé:v sur:o la:o glace:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Walton wrote all of it down that night, and he told his sister in a long letter to England.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o Walton:o consigna:v tout:o par:o écrit:n ,:o et:o il:o en:o fit:v le:o récit:n à:o sa:o sœur:n dans:o une:o longue:a lettre:n pour:o l':o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: He knew that the story was true, because he had seen the giant on the ice himself.
sentences.tgt: Il:o savait:v que:o l':o histoire:n était:v vraie:a ,:o car:o il:o avait:v vu:v de:o ses:o propres:a yeux:n le:o géant:n sur:o la:o glace:n .:o

sentences.en: He looked at Victor, and he saw that Victor was very weak.
sentences.tgt: Il:o regarda:v Victor:o et:o vit:v qu':o il:o était:v très:a faible:a .:o

sentences.en: "Rest now," Walton said, "and we will talk again in the morning."
sentences.tgt: «:o Reposez:v -vous:o ,:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v Walton:o ,:o «:o nous:o reparlerons:v demain:a matin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: For many days the ship did not move, and the ice was all around it.
sentences.tgt: Des:o jours:n durant:o ,:o le:o navire:n resta:v immobile:a ,:o cerné:a par:o les:o glaces:n .:o

sentences.en: Walton was afraid that his men would die on the ice, and the men were afraid too.
sentences.tgt: Walton:o craignait:v que:o ses:o hommes:n ne:o meurent:v sur:o la:o glace:n ,:o et:o ses:o hommes:n avaient:v peur:n eux:o aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Victor grew weaker every day, but he sat with Walton each night and spoke of his work.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o s':o affaiblissait:v de:o jour:n en:o jour:n ,:o mais:o chaque:o soir:n il:o s':o asseyait:v auprès:o de:o Walton:o et:o lui:o parlait:v de:o son:o travail:n .:o

sentences.en: One morning the ice broke with a loud sound, and the sea opened ahead of the ship.
sentences.tgt: Un:o matin:n ,:o la:o glace:n se:o rompit:v dans:o un:o grand:a fracas:n ,:o et:o la:o mer:n s':o ouvrit:v devant:o le:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: The men came to Walton, and one man said, "If the ship is free, you must turn south."
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n vinrent:v trouver:v Walton:o ,:o et:o l':o un:o d':o eux:o dit:v ::o «:o Si:o le:o navire:n est:v dégagé:a ,:o vous:o devez:v mettre:v le:o cap:n au:o sud:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We want to go home, and we do not want to die here."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o voulons:v rentrer:v chez:o nous:o ,:o et:o nous:o ne:o voulons:v pas:o mourir:v ici:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Victor stood up, and he was so weak that he could hardly stand.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o se:o leva:v ;:o il:o était:v si:a faible:a qu':o il:o avait:v peine:n à:o se:o tenir:v debout:a .:o

sentences.en: The men were quiet, and they looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n se:o turent:v et:o le:o regardèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: "Why did you come here?" he asked the men.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a êtes:v -vous:o venus:v ici:a ?:o »:o leur:o demanda:v -t-il:o .:o

sentences.en: "Did you come for an easy road?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Cherchiez:v -vous:o une:o route:n facile:a ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "You knew that the sea was hard and the ice was cold."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o saviez:v que:o la:o mer:n serait:v rude:a et:o la:o glace:n froide:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Be brave, and do not go home like men who ran away."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ayez:v du:o courage:n ,:o et:o ne:o rentrez:v pas:o chez:o vous:o en:o fuyards:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: But the men did not answer, and they looked at the floor.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o les:o hommes:n ne:o répondirent:v pas:o ,:o et:o ils:o baissèrent:v les:o yeux:n .:o

sentences.en: Walton did not want to turn back, but he could not make his men go on.
sentences.tgt: Walton:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o faire:v demi-tour:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o forcer:v ses:o hommes:n à:o continuer:v .:o

sentences.en: "I must turn the ship south," Walton said to Victor, "because I cannot make my men die."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o dois:v mettre:v le:o cap:n au:o sud:n ,:o »:o dit:v Walton:o à:o Victor:o ,:o «:o car:o je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o envoyer:v mes:o hommes:n à:o la:o mort:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Go home, then," Victor said, "but I will not go with you."
sentences.tgt: «:o Rentrez:v donc:o ,:o »:o dit:v Victor:o ,:o «:o mais:o je:o ne:o vous:o suivrai:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: That night Victor was very sick, and Walton sat by his bed.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o Victor:o fut:v très:a malade:a ,:o et:o Walton:o veilla:v à:o son:o chevet:n .:o

sentences.en: "I have done a bad thing, and I cannot undo it," Victor said to Walton.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v commis:v une:o faute:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o la:o réparer:v ,:o »:o dit:v Victor:o à:o Walton:o .:o

sentences.en: "If you see the creature, do not listen to it, because it will say that it is good."
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o vous:o voyez:v la:o créature:n ,:o ne:o l':o écoutez:v pas:o ,:o car:o elle:o vous:o dira:v qu':o elle:o est:v bonne:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Be happy at home, and do not look for great things."
sentences.tgt: «:o Soyez:v heureux:a chez:o vous:o ,:o et:o ne:o poursuivez:v pas:o de:o grands:a desseins:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Victor said the names of Elizabeth and Henry and William, and then he did not speak again.
sentences.tgt: Victor:o prononça:v les:o noms:n d':o Élisabeth:o ,:o d':o Henry:o et:o de:o William:o ,:o puis:a il:o ne:o dit:v plus:o rien:o .:o

sentences.en: He died that night, and Walton sat by him until the morning.
sentences.tgt: Il:o mourut:v cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o et:o Walton:o resta:v auprès:o de:o lui:o jusqu':o au:o matin:n .:o

sentences.en: Walton was in his room when he heard a sound in the room where Victor lay.
sentences.tgt: Walton:o était:v dans:o sa:o cabine:n lorsqu':o il:o entendit:v un:o bruit:n dans:o celle:o où:o reposait:v Victor:o .:o

sentences.en: He went in, and he saw a giant by the bed, and its face was hidden by long hair.
sentences.tgt: Il:o entra:v et:o vit:v un:o géant:n près:o du:o lit:n ,:o le:o visage:n caché:a par:o de:o longs:a cheveux:n .:o

sentences.en: One hand was out, and it was bigger than any hand that Walton had seen.
sentences.tgt: Il:o tendait:v une:o main:n ,:o plus:a grande:a que:o toutes:o celles:o que:o Walton:o avait:v jamais:a vues:v .:o

sentences.en: Walton was afraid, and he did not move.
sentences.tgt: Walton:o eut:v peur:n ,:o et:o il:o resta:v immobile:a .:o

sentences.en: "Victor!" the creature said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Victor:o !:o »:o s':o écria:v la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: "Forgive me!"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pardonne:v -moi:o !:o »:o

sentences.en: The creature looked at Victor's face and did not see Walton.
sentences.tgt: La:o créature:n contemplait:v le:o visage:n de:o Victor:o et:o ne:o voyait:v pas:o Walton:o .:o

sentences.en: "You come too late," Walton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o arrivez:v trop:a tard:a ,:o »:o dit:v Walton:o .:o

sentences.en: "You killed all that Victor loved, and if you had been sorry before, he would be alive."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o avez:v tué:v tous:o ceux:o que:o Victor:o aimait:v ,:o et:o si:o vous:o vous:o étiez:v repenti:v plus:a tôt:a ,:o il:o serait:v encore:a en:o vie:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Do you think that I am not sorry?" the creature said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Croyez:v -vous:o donc:o que:o je:o n':o aie:v pas:o de:o remords:n ?:o »:o dit:v la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: "I was alone, and no man was good to me, and I killed William and Justine."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o étais:v seul:a ,:o nul:o homme:n n':o était:v bon:a pour:o moi:o ,:o et:o j':o ai:v tué:v William:o et:o Justine:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I killed Elizabeth and Henry too, and I was afraid of what I had done."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v tué:v Élisabeth:o et:o Henry:o aussi:a ,:o et:o ce:o que:o j':o avais:v fait:v m':o a:v rempli:v d':o effroi:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I wanted only a friend, and I did not get one."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o voulais:v qu':o un:o ami:n ,:o et:o je:o n':o en:o ai:v jamais:o eu:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Victor made me, and Victor ran from me, and all men ran from me," the creature said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Victor:o m':o a:v façonné:v ,:o puis:a Victor:o m':o a:v fui:v ,:o et:o tous:o les:o hommes:n m':o ont:v fui:v ,:o »:o dit:v la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: "Do not say that I am bad, Walton, because you do not know what I have felt."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ne:o dites:v pas:o que:o je:o suis:v méchant:a ,:o Walton:o ,:o car:o vous:o ne:o savez:v pas:o ce:o que:o j':o ai:v enduré:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I was good when I was made, and I loved all that I saw."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o étais:v bon:a quand:o on:o m':o a:v façonné:v ,:o et:o j':o aimais:v tout:o ce:o que:o je:o voyais:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Victor is dead, and I have no one."
sentences.tgt: «:o Victor:o est:v mort:a ,:o et:o je:o n':o ai:v plus:o personne:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "No man is as bad as I am, and no man will be my friend."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nul:o homme:n n':o est:v aussi:a méchant:a que:o moi:o ,:o et:o nul:o homme:n ne:o voudra:v être:v mon:o ami:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will go north over the ice, and I will make a big fire and burn myself."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v partir:v vers:o le:o nord:n ,:o par-delà:o les:o glaces:n ,:o et:o j':o allumerai:v un:o grand:a bûcher:n pour:o m':o y:o consumer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "No man will see me again, and I will not hurt any man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nul:o homme:n ne:o me:o reverra:v ,:o et:o je:o ne:o ferai:v plus:o de:o mal:n à:o personne:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: The creature jumped out of the window onto a raft of ice that lay near the ship.
sentences.tgt: La:o créature:n sauta:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n sur:o un:o radeau:n de:o glace:n qui:o flottait:v près:o du:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: The wind took the raft away into the dark, and Walton did not see the creature again.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vent:n emporta:v le:o radeau:n dans:o les:o ténèbres:n ,:o et:o Walton:o ne:o revit:v jamais:o la:o créature:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning the men turned the ship south, and the ship went home.
sentences.tgt: Au:o matin:n ,:o les:o hommes:n mirent:v le:o cap:n au:o sud:n ,:o et:o le:o navire:n rentra:v au:o pays:n .:o
